name: Greer
self_text: I’m a biology grad in my early 30s, Aussie by birth, preferring to keep my gender private. My current focus is programming. I thrive studying independently together, and I like talking things through as we progress. I’m happy online and can easily meet on Sunday mornings. When I’m not coding, I enjoy woodworking and the quiet it brings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available Sunday morning, and I need us to overlap online. I’d strongly prefer that you are into studying independently side by side, but I won’t rule you out over it. I’d strongly prefer that you are into programming, though it’s not a requirement. I’d strongly prefer that you are okay with occasional short exchanges or talking things through as we go, but I won’t rule you out over it.
